hints.title: Suffix Subproblem
hints.text: Let ways[i] be the number of valid arrays that can be formed from suffix s[i:].

hints.title: Leading Zero Check
hints.text: If s[i] == 0, no number in [1, k] can begin with 0, so dp[i] = 0.

hints.title: Bounded Integer Window
hints.text: Otherwise, parse integers of length up to 10 (since k <= 10^9). While parsed integer <= k, add dp[j + 1] to dp[i] modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exponential branching when exploring all integer partitions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since numbers cannot exceed k <= 10^9, inner loop runs at most 10 iterations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements linear scan with bounded inner loop and modulo arithmetic.
